guard: a Claude seat must receive CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN (the deploy-doc credential) and must not receive CLAUDE_CODE_CHILD_SESSION
why: After launchEnv stopped inheriting, this connector called it with no providerKeys, so
CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN — the name docs/deploy.md and deploy/ tell operators a container
Claude authenticates with — was silently absent. A container has no Keychain. Dropping
providerKeys from the launchEnv call is the measured defect, and the named cell is the
token the docs promise, not a prefix of CLAUDE_CODE_*.
SPECIFIER BOUNDARY. The suite imports ../src/extension.js and calls buildLaunch directly:
no dist in the path, no build in the command. The bytes mutated are the bytes graded.

mutations.name: drop Claude providerKeys so CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN never reaches the child
mutations.find: ...launchEnv({ providerKeys: CLAUDE_PROVIDER_KEYS, mcpKeys: mcpServerEnvKeys(shared), envAllow: opts.envAllow }),
mutations.note: The 0.30.1-allowlist regression: an allowlist that silently drops the credential the deploy docs promise. Host-session markers stay withheld either way, so the marker cell stays green and the two cells discriminate.
